sections.title: Trial class: €60
paragraphs: A trial class of 60 minutes as Personal Yoga: your own one-to-one session with Susanne. Write to us to arrange your class.

sections.title: What to expect
list: New to yoga? No problem: the classes suit beginners and advanced practitioners alike.
Bring a water bottle and a small towel. If you have a yoga mat, feel free to bring it, otherwise you can use our studio mats.
Arrive 5 to 15 minutes before the start so you can settle in.
Wear comfortable clothes you can move in. You do not need shoes.
Please let me know before class about injuries, pregnancy or medical problems.

sections.title: Collect your Yoga Momente.
sections.text: On request, you receive our little YogaCard when you sign up. It helps you keep track of the classes you have completed and reminds you of your Yoga Momente at home.
